Hi all —

Thanks, Jordan — we've pulled together the initial package and answers. Attaching the items below and summarizing key points here so Carlos/Alice can triage quickly.

Attachments included (zipped for brevity):
- IR_Policy_v2.pdf (Incident Response Policy, version 2)
- BCP_DR_Summary.xlsx (Executive BCP/DR one-pager with RTO/RPO targets)
- SOC2-Report-2025.pdf (last completed SOC 2 Type II report — redacted for public distribution)
- FintechCorp_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx (starter answers — please review)

Summary / direct answers to FTQ (incident response & breach notification):
- Detection & acknowledgement: Our monitoring & detection pipelines surface an incident to the security team within an average of 0-24 hours depending on signal severity. Critical alerts are automatically paged.
- Initial assessment: Security team performs triage and impact assessment within 24 hours of detection; we aim to have an internal Post-Incident Assessment (PIA) kickoff within 48 hours.
- Customer notification: For incidents confirmed to have impacted customer data, standard practice is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirmation. For regulated timelines (e.g., breach notification statutes), we coordinate with legal and will meet statutory deadlines; the 72-hour window is our standard customer-facing SLA for confirmed data-impacting events unless contractually specified otherwise.
- Regulatory notification: Where applicable (e.g., PII breaches under GDPR), we work with legal to submit required notices to regulators within statutory timelines; Redwood does not unilaterally set regulator timelines — we follow legal counsel for the jurisdiction.
- Escalation & contact: Primary security contact: security@redwood.com. For higher-severity incidents, we provide a named incident lead and regular status updates (initial assessment, containment, remediation plan, root cause, and retrospective).

BCP/DR highlights (from BCP_DR_Summary.xlsx):
- Recovery time objective (RTO): Typical infra/service level RTO is 4-24 hours depending on component.
- Recovery point objective (RPO): We maintain continuous data replication for production KV caches and critical state; RPO targets vary by service tier (near-zero for dedicated customers, under 1 hour for standard hosted).
- Tabletop & drills: We run quarterly tabletop exercises and annual full DR recovery tests; summaries of the last exercises are in the attached one-pager.

SOC 2 note: Attached SOC2-Report-2025.pdf is our most recent completed report; 2026 Type II is in progress and expected Q1 2027. We can provide a bridge letter if needed.

Next steps:
- Carlos / Alice: please review the attached questionnaire answers and the documents. Tell us if you need redacted/expanded versions or sign NDA-specific sharing for full SOC artifacts.
- Jordan / Marissa: I can join a 30-min call with Carlos to walk the package.
